stories.why: The one flashpoint that hits gold through every channel at once. asia.read: Asian equities are broadly lower, averaging -0.60%. Risk came off overnight, which normally gives gold a small bid into London. asia.caveat: Measured from 00:00 UK to 06:55. Tokyo closes around 07:00 UK and Hong Kong around 09:00, so this is a session finishing rather than one that has finished.

correlations.regime: Gold and the dollar are running at -0.49. That is the textbook inverse relationship, so dollar moves are doing real work on the price. Against the S&P it is +0.39.
